hypotheses: `full` finds more seeded issues than `lite` at a higher cost.
`superpowers` costs less than `lite` but misses the project-specific issues (collision, wrong path, tenancy).
Run-to-run variation within one arm is small enough (cost range under half the median) to compare arms with three replicates.
decision_rule: Prune an arm only if it is dominated (higher median cost, lower median rubric total, no more seeded issues found, and non-overlapping ranges) by another arm. Among the survivors the operator picks the arms for the W7 run; the report declares no winner.
